title: 100 days to go: Packaging Innovations & Empack 2027 puts innovation to the test
summary: With just 100 days until the UK's biggest packaging and processing event returns to the NEC Birmingham, more than 500 suppliers, leading global brands and industry experts are preparing to showcase practical solutions to the industry's biggest challenges

extraction.key_fact: 영국 최대 패키징 행사 Packaging Innovations & Empack 2027이 NEC 버밍엄에서 열릴 예정이다.
